status: declared by the pull request that closes #477 before any score was computed; nothing here is tuned on a scored day. Every input is already collected and already readable as-of; none is added to the panel, to metadata/sources.json or to contract.py, and none is on in any published declaration.
passers: the five tier-1 passers of #428 (docs/pivot/risk-date-severity-result.md), as metadata/risk_date_severity.json declares them: risk_gbm, risk_gbm_base, risk_logistic, risk_logistic_base, risk_quantile_skewt_base. Their estimators, risk-date rule, inputs and the exact-zero forecast on other days are unchanged; only the declared group is added to the inputs.
control: each candidate's control is its own passer, scored by this script on the same scratch panel and fold grid, so a difference is the group's and nothing else

settle.label: settlements-forward
settle.source: treasury_auction_net_settlement (metadata/net_settlement.json, #426): public at 12:00 ET on the row's own day (release_lag days 0), so read at every horizon

dealer.label: dealer and segment
dealer.source: dealer_treasury_position: nyfed_fr2004, six business days after the as-of date (published panel column, weekly, staleness-guarded); fed_repo_*: nyfed_repo_ops, 16:00 ET on the next business day (#425), the conservative reading, not the same-day one

left_out.ofr_tri_rate: observed on 1324 of 1935 scratch-panel rows, none before 2020-09-09 (OFR real-time start; earlier values were filled in after the fact and are not read)
left_out.ofr_gcf_rate: observed on 144 of 1935 rows, none before 2020-10-23
left_out.why: the direct pressure design refuses an unobserved input (ml._PressureDesign._value) and a missing-value indicator or zero-fill would be a new design choice. Leaving them in would drop every scored day before September 2020, which includes 2018 and 2020, the years this test is about. They stay unused, and the pull request flags the choice for Eleonora.

policy.label: policy
policy.source: policy_register (metadata/policy_features.json, #412): computed from entries announced at or before 16:00 ET on the row's own date, so read at every horizon

columns_at_horizon: every group column is read at every horizon; the passers' own rule that treasury_settlement and treasury_settlement_coupons leave the inputs at h >= 2 is unchanged
new_availability_guard: none. No column is added to the panel or to the registries; each is read through the existing as-of rule at the lag its source declares, and the guards that govern those reads are already tested (tests/test_net_settlement.py, tests/test_policy_features.py, tests/test_fed_liquidity.py, tests/test_asof.py)
judge: scripts/pressure_judge.py judge, tiers 1, 3 and 5 under the rule in force; flag cut-offs chosen by metadata/pressure_judge.json's cutoff_rule from each refit's training window alone; none is declared here
published_declaration: off. No candidate is named in confirmation.candidates; no figure on any published page moves.
